reason: 本文を確認したが、対象系統との接続またはLLM推論効率の実証が弱く、一般化可能性を確認できない。Fractal Generative Models introduce a visual autoregressive generation architecture. The paper focuses on model/generation quality and does not establish a general LLM inference-systems improvement despite the broad lineage label.
title: Fractal Generative Models
